evidence.note: after-landed: WriterBasedJsonGenerator writes doubles straight into its char buffer instead of through a String. The task tree is the merge

status_reason: built here, and the oracle ran on the task and reference trees (see runs); the workload was run too, but only in an earlier form (below). Built with the project's Maven wrapper and the JDK on the PATH (Eclipse Temurin 21. The workload runs recorded here predate the warm-up rule now in the committed workload (a floor of 200 iterations, 1% tolerance, a cap of 600 that reports instead of failing); the iteration bodies are unchanged, but the program that ran is not the committed one, so workload.verified is false until it is run again on a quiet machine.
